origin: Original offline sound design for The Last Ward. No voice recordings, copyrighted game audio or third-party samples.

files.design: Twelve quiet irregular 5.3–6.3 second close-air cycles: nasal inhale, warmer mouth exhale, asymmetric airflow and changing rests. No voice/grunt recording.
Twelve moderately paced irregular 3.5–4.2 second cycles with independent inhale/exhale resonances and breathing depth.
Twelve strained irregular 2.6–3.1 second cycles: audible close breath with short rests, no voiced groans or pain syllables.
Quiet 40 second transformer/ventilation bed with crossfaded air and steady 50 Hz mains harmonics.
40 second fuller low machine/ventilation bed, no recurrent impacts or rattles.
36 second crossfaded low winter wind with slow broad gusts, no rhythmic percussive loop.
Original 460 ms soft two-note item confirmation cue, no bottle/dishes recording or game sample.
Original 380 ms filtered-air cloth handling foley, without glass clinks.
